fastspring_account_created_trigger.description: Runs each time an account is created in FastSpring. Ones created before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, processed, created, type, live, data.id, data.account, data.contact, data.address, data.language, data.country, data.lookup, data.url, event
